objective.statement: Put the Purpose/ADR-0000 doctrine and operating mindset in every managed agent backbone while keeping one canonical doctrine source.
objective.measure: Focused contract proof verifies canonical-text inclusion in Codex and the installed jcode overlay, and rejects deprecated umans routing.

need.statement: jcode receives routing-only swarm instructions and no Purpose backbone, while its route still names deprecated Umans models.
need.baseline: config/agents/purpose-backbone.md and ~/.jcode/prompt-overlay.md are absent; config/jcode/swarm-prompt.md contains the Umans route.
need.consequence_of_no_action: jcode agents can run without the shared doctrine and can select a deprecated provider route.
alternatives_considered: Install a static overlay unrelated to the Codex source

purpose: Give Codex and jcode the same Purpose/ADR-0000 doctrine from one durable source.
consumer: jcode coordinators and workers, Codex sessions, and the operator.
contract: The canonical doctrine file is the source for Codex developer_instructions and the Home Manager-installed jcode prompt overlay; the overlay also carries the specified operating mindset; the swarm prompt routes only through current Kimi/MiniMax/Ollama policy and contains no umans route.
failureBoundary: Do not edit live home projections, run home-manager switch, read secrets, alter unrelated provider credentials, or change the Codex doctrine text except for the explicit canonical-source wiring and requested mindset/routing extension.

evidence.description: python3 scripts/test-purpose-backbone.py proves RED/GREEN canonical inclusion, overlay generation wiring, and no umans route.
python3 scripts/test-codex-preferences.py and node --test scripts/test-nix-tooling.mjs prove regressions remain green.
nix build --no-link path:.#homeConfigurations.<profile>.activationPackage evaluates the Home Manager configuration.

falsifier.claim: A Home Manager activation can install a jcode overlay containing the canonical doctrine while Codex continues to use the same doctrine and deprecated umans routing is absent.

executable_check.expected: non-zero before implementation; zero after implementation

invariants: Codex developer_instructions retain the existing doctrine text byte-for-byte
Canonical doctrine has one tracked source
Umans is not a routing option

assumptions.statement: Home Manager Nix evaluation can read the tracked canonical Markdown file with builtins.readFile.
assumptions.falsifier: The declared home configuration fails Nix evaluation because the path cannot be read.

assumptions.statement: The dotfiles facade's worktree-create command is the current equivalent of the requested workspace-create command.
assumptions.falsifier: Live facade help exposes a workspace-create command and rejects worktree-create.

plane_constraints: Canonical doctrine lives in dotfiles; generated projections remain Home Manager/Codex-managed.
